name: personal-outlook-mcp
description: Read and act on your personal Outlook inbox and calendar from Claude. Each user runs the server locally with their own Azure AD app registration; tokens never leave the machine.
long_description:
**Personal Outlook MCP** exposes a personal Outlook (consumer Microsoft account) inbox and calendar to MCP clients like Claude Desktop via the Microsoft Graph API.

## What you get

**Email tools** (`personal_email_*`):
- List folders, list recent messages (with unread filter), full-text/KQL search
- Read full messages with body in text or HTML
- Mark read/unread, move between folders, soft-delete or hard-delete
- Send new mail, reply (with optional reply-all), create drafts, send drafts later
- List and download attachments to disk

**Calendar tools** (`personal_calendar_*`):
- List calendars (primary, holidays, custom group calendars)
- List events in a date range with recurring series expanded to occurrences
- Read full event details including attendees, body, recurrence pattern
- Create / update / cancel events
- Respond to meeting invites (accept / tentatively / decline)

## How it works

- **Local stdio only** — no hosted backend, no proxy. Your tokens stay in the OS keyring.
- **MSAL device-code OAuth** — first run prompts you in a terminal to sign in via browser; subsequent runs refresh silently.
- **Bring your own Azure AD app** — register a free app in the Azure portal (~5 minutes); the MCP server uses your client ID. Step-by-step guide in the repo README.
- **Scopes**: `Mail.ReadWrite`, `Mail.Send`, `Calendars.ReadWrite`, `User.Read`, `offline_access`.

## Distribution note

This `.mcpb` bundle is built for **macOS arm64** only because the OS-keyring native binary is platform-specific. Users on other platforms (Intel Mac, Windows, Linux) should install via `npx -y @jaingxyz/personal-outlook-mcp`, which fetches the right native binary at install time. See the [README](https://github.com/jaingxyz/personal-outlook-mcp#readme) for full setup.

azure_client_id.description: Application (client) ID from your own Azure AD app registration. See https://github.com/jaingxyz/personal-outlook-mcp#azure-setup for the 5-minute setup.

azure_tenant.title: Azure tenant
azure_tenant.description: Tenant identifier. 'consumers' for personal Microsoft accounts, 'common' to also accept work/school, or a specific tenant GUID.

timezone.title: Display timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone used to render calendar event times (e.g. America/Los_Angeles, America/New_York, Europe/London).
